title: Single Analyse focus + source/media hardening
summary: YTIntel is temporarily focused back onto one excellent Analyse workflow. Compare is removed from desktop/mobile navigation and its Vault UI is hidden. The research roadmap is reduced to a compact floating progress bar, Activity lives in a closed technical drawer, the Strip is rebuilt from source-only facts, the short summary is grounded in actual timed transcript moments, takeaways require source receipts, package records are explicitly vaulted for large-scale thumbnail/title pattern mining, channel zero placeholders are suppressed, Make It Yours is clearly separated from transferable-mechanics extraction, the raw Vault entry is hidden, and Export is an AI-ready Markdown copy/download surface. Media-heavy sections now surface real storyboard/audio evidence already collected by the Endgame engine and add a unified timestamped media timeline when measured visual, motion, audio or replay events exist.
discord_changes: SINGLE-VIDEO FOCUS: Compare is removed for now so development stays concentrated on making Analyse genuinely excellent.
ANALYSE CLEANUP: one compact progress popup, folded Activity, rebuilt source-only Strip, grounded short summary, receipt-backed takeaways, hidden raw Vault entry and clean AI-ready Markdown export.

MEDIA + PACKAGE FOUNDATION: package records are explicitly vaulted for thumbnail/title pattern mining, while measured storyboard, motion, audio and replay evidence can now converge into one timestamped media timeline.
changes: Removed Compare from desktop navigation, mobile navigation and the active product surface while preserving historical comparison data internally.
Removed the visible Comparisons bank control from the Vault while Compare is parked.
Converted the research roadmap into a compact floating progress popup that cycles through the current analysis stage and fades after completion.
Moved Activity/technical receipts outside the progress popup into a closed details drawer.

Rebuilt the Strip as a source-only fact surface: title, channel, inferred source niche/subniche, views, subscribers, likes, comments, duration, WPM, channel median and outlier; missing public values render as a dash rather than zero.
Separated source classification from Creator DNA so a GTA 6 creator profile can no longer relabel a YouTube-business source video as GTA 6.
Rebuilt the Summary around the Blake-style short-version structure using actual timed transcript evidence rather than a generic main-message sentence or opening/development labels.
Rebuilt Key Takeaways to require a timestamp and exact supporting source receipt for each lesson.
Kept Hook Breakdown intact and retained the Monday-brief re-hook/payoff/Most-Replayed logic from the v0.37.1 repair layer.
Reformatted Things to Steal when that legacy section is present into transferable mechanics versus do-not-copy guidance.
Clarified Make It Yours as the Creator-DNA-specific build sheet rather than another extraction section.

Hardened Packaging as a first-class Package Bank asset containing the exact thumbnail, title fingerprint, available composition/text/attention-device reads, and source niche/subniche for future pattern mining.
Added a unified timestamped media timeline when measured visual, motion, audio or Most-Replayed evidence is available, tied back to nearby transcript text.
Added explicit media receipts for semantic frame-pair classifications, sampled visual-change density, decoded waveform state, measured silence/transients and semantic audio windows when available.
Suppressed missing channel analytics that previously appeared as zero and added an explicit channel-fact receipt.
Hidden the raw Vault Entry from Analyse while continuing to bank the analysis underneath.
Rebuilt Export as Copy full analysis Markdown, Download Markdown and Print / Save PDF, excluding the hidden raw Vault entry and including the transcript appendix when available.
Updated production browser tests so Compare being absent is now a regression requirement on desktop and mobile.
known_limitations: YouTube does not expose a reliable Most Replayed curve for every video. Missing replay evidence remains missing rather than being fabricated.
Public storyboard sprites are sampled seek-bar evidence rather than every encoded frame. Exact encoded-frame-by-frame semantic analysis remains an active Endgame workstream.

Automatic visual composition and exact edit-type classification are strongest when the optional on-device vision model is ready. Without it, YTIntel keeps actual source frames and measured pixel-change evidence separate from semantic claims.
Waveform-level silence/transient analysis requires a directly decodable public audio stream. Music/SFX semantic labels additionally require accessible metadata or the supported on-device audio model.
Deterministic source niche/subniche inference is materially safer than using Creator DNA but is still classification, not a YouTube-provided field; it should be treated as YTIntel inference.
Watchtower velocity still depends on repeated snapshots; a newly added competitor has no historical velocity until it has been observed more than once.
why_it_matters: The current bottleneck is not another tab. It is making one-link analysis so useful that the creator can understand the winning video without watching it and leave with a source-grounded blueprint for what to make. v0.37.3 deliberately narrows the product around that job while strengthening the media and packaging evidence that will later power the compounding Vault.
